name: Squibler
tagline: Turn an idea into a full book, novel or screenplay with AI.
description: Squibler is an AI writing platform for long-form fiction and screenwriting that drafts outlines, chapters, characters and settings from a prompt, then helps edit and refine the manuscript. It includes an AI co-author, a distraction-free editor, story templates, and AI image generation for scenes, with support for 80+ languages. Plans range from a limited free tier to paid Plus and Pro subscriptions.

modelSupport.notes: Built-in AI co-author for drafting, outlining and editing long-form work.

edge: Generates whole books and screenplays from a prompt — with AI scene images and 80+ language support — inside one distraction-free long-form editor.
